turns.prompt:
Complete this 6x6 Latin square (each of 1-6 exactly once in every row and column; rows and columns numbered 1-6, '.' is empty):
6 . 1 2 . 5
. 1 . 6 . .
. 5 3 . . 6
. . 6 3 1 .
. 6 2 . 4 1
. 3 . . . .

Record your completion by filling ONE empty cell per reply with the shell command `echo R C V >> moves.txt` (row, column, value), until every empty cell is filled. Wait for each command's result before the next. After the last cell, reply with the single word done.
